result.question: Em qual mês de cada ano (2008-2023) ocorreu o maior número de internações em UTI?
result.gold_sql: SELECT ano, mes, total_uti FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "DT_INTER") AS mes, COUNT(*) AS total_uti, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano, mes) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ano;
result.generated_sql: SELECT "ano", "mes_internacao", "total" FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS "ano", EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "DT_INTER") AS "mes_internacao", COUNT(*) AS "total", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 AND "DT_INTER" >= '2008-01-01' AND "DT_INTER" < '2024-01-01' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER"), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "DT_INTER") ) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY "ano";
